requirement_match.summary: Implementation stays within the approved workflow/helper/test/document scope.

security.summary: No production mutation, credentials in archives, force flags or dotenv overrides introduced.

code_quality.summary: Initial review found deployment-lock parity and lint issues requiring fixes.

failure_paths.summary: Initial orphan-tag and archive portability gaps required correction.

error_handling.summary: Deployment errors do not publish success; retries cannot move tags or overwrite conflicting artifacts.

findings.summary: Separate Functions lock differed from the workspace graph used by tests.

findings.summary: A tag created before draft/asset upload could make a rerun unrecoverable.
findings.resolution: Recover retained artifacts from the exact original SHA/main release workflow and create only missing metadata.

findings.summary: New Node globals/text sanitizer regex and macOS tar fixture needed portability/lint fixes.
findings.resolution: Use Node imports and safe character handling; suppress macOS archive metadata only for fixtures; rerun ESLint/actionlint/tests.

residual_risks: Provider setup and execution evidence missing.
limitations: Review is a self-review, not a separate reviewer or production certification.
